text: The flower bark, Captain Peterty of 2oz ton and 40 men, failed from Macao in July 1786. Her left- nation was KamelChalke (for which die was provided with a finished cover of arreak, tea. Ke), Copper Illands and the M.W. one. Captain Peterter who are refited to make his pafage between Japan and Corea, and examine the illands as the north of Japan had its he inhabited by her people which, if Captain Cook had lived, would not have been left to the French to determine.
